review:
Laura Loot explores Aztec ruins on 25 lines with cascades and a progressive multiplier map that moves forward every time wins and refills happen.

Hit milestones on the map to unlock prize chests, so there's always a clear goal. Medium-high volatility, 5,000x max and 97.07% RTP, with free spins about once every 159 spins. A story-driven game with a real sense of progress.
pros: Excellent 97.07% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
